power_reconstruction.formula: P(k)=2 pi^2 As (k/k_pivot)^(ns-1) T(k)^2/k^3 in Mpc^3, then h^3 and k/h
power_reconstruction.comoving_direct: direct synchronous v_baryon_cdm used in the refined CLASS-compatible comoving transfer
power_reconstruction.comoving_recovered: Newtonian-subtracted velocity retained as a separate numerical diagnostic
power_reconstruction.synchronous_native: native delta_tot on the same full q grid
power_reconstruction.sign: squaring removes the CAMB/CLASS initial-curvature sign; no additional sign is applied to power

common_grid.actual_maximum_rule: minimum of 2.0 and every source endpoint; no extrapolation

methods.raw: log-log interpolation onto the common grid without smoothing
methods.smooth_0.05dex: Gaussian smoothing of ln(P), sigma=0.05 dex
methods.smooth_0.10dex: Gaussian smoothing of ln(P), sigma=0.10 dex
methods.integration: arithmetic mean of k^3 P(k)/(2 pi^2) in natural log k, integrate before zero/baseline ratios

output_rule: Write new comoving-power and comoving-bandpower artifacts without changing earlier summaries or raw data.
boundaries: No physical parameter changes, new solver run, or nonzero CDM placeholder.
Gauge transformation is now included before band integration; other implementation systematics remain independent.
No observational likelihood, covariance, joint BBN, nonlinear calculation, or model-family exclusion.
